description: Give a private app's service token a new value without an outage, and write the new value straight into each caller's secret env var. Each caller restarts to read it. The old value keeps working for a fixed overlap (20 minutes by default), so callers move over before it stops; the answer says when. The value never passes through this conversation. deliver_to names the callers, apps or agents in the same organization; omit it to deliver to the callers the token's earlier rotations recorded, which list_app_tokens shows. A rotation with no caller to deliver to is refused here, because its value would have to be shown: run `valet apps token rotate` in a terminal for a token used outside Valet. A token rotates again only after its old value stops working; a repeat before then is refused, so a retried call never rotates twice. A token that does not exist yet is minted. Requires connecting a Valet account. Requires the Admin role.

deliver_to.description: The callers to write the new value into. Omit to use the callers the token recorded.

app.description: The caller's name: an app or agent in the same organization.

env_var.description: The secret env var on the caller that holds the token, such as BILLING_TOKEN.

name.description: The app's name, as list_services shows it: the app whose tokens these are.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

token.description: The token's name, as list_app_tokens shows it.

name: rotate_app_token

delivered.description: True when the caller holds the new value; it restarts to read it.

env_var.description: The env var the value was written into.

reason.description: Why the delivery failed. Absent when delivered.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

retiring_until.description: When the old value stops working, RFC 3339. Absent when the rotation minted the token's first value.

title: Rotate an app's service token
